turns.assessment: The failure is confined to the S07→S03 optical direction: every monitored channel disappears, beginning with loss of input power at the booster, while the reverse S03→S07 direction remains normal. Loss at the booster input localizes the break ahead of the amplifier and rules strongly against an amplifier failure or downstream fibre cut. The recent S07 maintenance further supports a disconnected or broken OMS input patch at S07.

proposals.rationale: A pulled input patch at oms.S07-S03 removes all channels before amp0, matching lost input and output power at every amplifier, downstream OCH LOS, and the OCM losses at S03. Reverse-direction monitoring is unchanged, as expected for this directional patch fault.
